facts.label: Agora e instruções
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + verbo-ing para agora: It’s charging. Use o verbo base para pedir: Take my charger. Look behind the sofa.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + verbo-ing: I’m plugging it in. It’s charging. Para negar, diga It isn’t charging. Para pergunta: Is it charging?

facts.label: Instruções
facts.sub: Para dar uma instrução, use o verbo base no começo: Take my charger. Look behind the sofa. Wait a minute. Sem o you, e com um tom amigável, fica natural.

pages.title: A cozy apartment · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday evening in a cozy apartment in Houston. Rain taps on the window. Seth is in the kitchen with a kettle. His friend Ben comes in with a worried face. His phone is almost dead. Seth asks him a question.
“Ben, why are you looking at your phone?” says Seth. “My battery is low. I’m worried!” says Ben. “Take my charger. It’s on the table.” says Seth.
